label: August 10–16, 2026
intro: One week until BICT Fest — grab your tickets now if you haven't. Meanwhile, Toob North keeps running at Cloud 11 and the rinks are wide open. A perfect workshop-and-skate week.
weekday_note: Weekday mornings at Cloud 11 are your best shot at hands-on maker time before the August 21 BICT surge.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.date: Book a weekend slot at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session price
activities.why: Hands-on pinch pots, slabs, and coils for kids age 5+. Thor gets to build and decorate something from scratch and take it home. Exactly the clay energy of the pottery classes he already loves — and ClassBento has sessions most weekends.
activities.tip: Book at classbento.co.th/ceramic-workshop-for-kids — weekend slots fill up, so book a few days ahead.

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; workshop sessions priced individually
activities.why: With only 3 weeks left of Toob North, this is a good moment to go if you haven't yet — or go again. Northern Thai potters and makers are at their most relaxed in mid-August. Great for hands-on clay and craft time.
activities.tip: Saturday or Sunday morning sessions tend to have the most interactive maker access.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekend or Weekday
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults (weekday); ~350–450 THB with rental (weekend)
activities.why: Both the Arena Rink (fun) and Academy Rink (coaching) are available. Mid-August weekends are quieter than school holiday peaks. Good week to get in a solid ice session before the BICT Fest programme fills your schedule.
activities.tip: A 60-min coached lesson (900 THB) is excellent value — Thor will notice real progress in a single session.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24
activities.why: Southeast Asia's biggest indoor roller rink — consistent week-on-week practice is how Thor's rollerblading improves. Coaches available, practice grass area for warm-up.
activities.tip: August 15 (Saturday) is the 3rd Saturday — theWHOLESOME Book Club at theCOMMONS Thonglor is on at 9am if you want to combine both in one day.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum
activities.location: Queen Sirikit Park, Chatuchak (Mo Chit BTS or Chatuchak Park MRT)
activities.why: Giant bubbles, dinosaur digs, tunnel of mirrors, Lego building zones, and an outdoor water park. Free, open-air, and hands-on — perfect rainy-season afternoon when you want something educational and fun without the chaos of a mall.
activities.tip: Go on a weekday to avoid weekend crowds. The outdoor water area is perfect for a hot afternoon — bring a change of clothes.

activities.title: 🎭 Book BICT Fest Tickets NOW — Festival Starts August 21
activities.location: One Bangkok Park + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes + ticketed shows on Eventpop
activities.why: 10th anniversary Bangkok International Children's Theatre Festival: 11 interactive shows from 9 countries. Theme 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' — participatory performances where kids are part of the action. Designed for ages baby to teen. BICT Fest 2026 is a rare, world-class programme for Bangkok kids.
activities.tip: Free programme slots go first and fast — don't wait until the week of the festival. Go to bictfest.com right now and grab your slots.
